tasks.title: Correct core Fixture security and Style A acceptance
tasks.spec: Start from exact accepted MVP-BASE-001 SHA 25f00004f83185be3d987424b28f627f3854b35d. Do not merge or cherry-pick rejected candidate e5e2cebd039ee9a9627fa7b819d3b6a3153aa8c7; it may be read only as a failed design reference. Rebuild the minimal canonical graph, testkit, and six @mvp-core Playwright specifications. Fix exactly three blockers. First, command bodies must not contain role, actor, space, scenario, content, or private text. A separately injected server-owned Fixture session context supplies the allowlisted scenario and role; command request schemas are strict and command-specific, and only private-message probe commands may carry a target ID. A partner session that submits subject, role, actor, space, content, scenario, or guessed private identifiers must fail closed with zero writes and no raw content. Second, define and assert the frozen Style A variables directly: #F4F1EA background, #FFFFFF surface, #1F1C17 text, #33513F primary, #8A5A3B accent, and #9C4E22 warning. Do not reuse the older contracts UI_CSS_VARIABLES as the visual expectation. Use a compact rail maximum of 330px and assert 16-20px core card vertical padding plus meaningful consent, report, responsibility, and handover depth. Third, the visible SupplyHandoverInfo action copy is exactly 补齐上次检查结果. Keep the accepted candidate's otherwise useful canonical graph, five persisted owners, blocked and two-confirmation states, atomic owner and reminder transfer, six focused test inventory, reload proof, and no-mock browser design, but recreate them without failed commit ancestry. Browser execution remains deferred until integration supplies routes.

update_tasks.spec: Start from the exact accepted MVP-BASE-001 SHA and verify accepted HAND-001 SHA 59e4bcb98be9d21432a92d02e7d01962bc4451cb is already an ancestor. Fetch and cleanly merge --no-ff only the exact accepted remote SHAs for MVP-CONV-001, MVP-RESP-001, MVP-EXPR-001, and replacement MVP-QA-002. Abort on conflict or unexpected ancestry, and verify rejected QA commit e5e2cebd039ee9a9627fa7b819d3b6a3153aa8c7 is not an ancestor. Add only integration-owned Fixture session, public command/query composition, database adapters, routes, and demo documentation. The page may establish one allowlisted local Fixture role session, but all subsequent command bodies must omit role, actor, space, scenario, content, and private text; derive them from the server-owned session and canonical graph. Unknown sessions and any tampered identity or content fields fail closed with zero writes. Wire the canonical journey through the real Next.js UI, public handlers, and PostgreSQL, including SupplyHandoverInfo from the exact 补齐上次检查结果 action before either confirmation. Keep provider behavior deterministic and credential-free. Do not patch product modules sideways or claim production readiness.
